frozen_components.retrieval_routes: BM25 Top-100 plus BGE-small dense Top-100

slate_policy.ranking_signature: intent version, rendered dense query, rendered lexical query, route weights, active requirement value/source/attribute, exclusions, ranking policy, complete ranked pool, and requested result count
slate_policy.changed_signature: reset seen IDs and select the first ranked window
slate_policy.unchanged_signature: select unseen candidates in rank order before any deterministic repeat backfill
slate_policy.override: requirement provenance changes the signature even when rendered query text is unchanged
slate_policy.candidate_exhaustion: backfill in ranked order without duplicates within one response
slate_policy.bounds: retain one current ranked-pool reference tuple and one shown-ID tuple, each bounded to the current fused union of at most 200 IDs per session
